## Positive methodology findings

- **Fail-closed stage/optimization ordering:** common.py's ordinary exception rejects optimization before CLI/store imports; worker/controller/analyzer/profile require the separate study+admission-bound root gate. Worker additionally requires explicit child env0 and recorded ordinary flags. Root receipts separate correctness/preflight from timing authorization. Saved preparation/admitted negative records are accurately scoped, not timing passes. Python optimization removes assertion code, so ordinary guards are appropriate. [Pinned CPython 3.12.14 statement documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.12.14/Doc/reference/simple_stmts.rst).
- **Comparison identity:** A changes the wrapper bundle while holding artifact480456… fixed; it does not isolate only one internal helper. B changes accepted wrapper+5b661… to proposed wrapper+480456… and is explicitly broader. Same closed 320-fact/10-commit file bytes, natural confined source roots and unmodified source caps/reader are part of the declared preparation and checked worker path; no prepared-table/evaluator substitute is used.
- **Actual public return endpoint:** worker.py:42–49 resolves the method before timing, times the complete query/query_json call, then normalizes/compares/checksums/logs outside the interval. Real transaction/budget/request preparation/native/FP/codec checks stay inside the public implementation. Import/copy/open setup and preconstructed Query objects are separate. This is elapsed return latency, not exclusive CPU or native-kernel time. [Pinned clock documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.12.14/Doc/library/time.rst).
- **Clustered analysis:** analyze.py:21–27 takes each process's median of three technical measurements, then 42 paired ratios and pair-resamples, retaining both rounds/load orders. There is no claim of 3,528 or 7,056 independent samples, pooling A+B, trimming or favorable minima. Repetition levels matter; using an execution-level cluster does not prove independence, warmup sufficiency or inference across builds/hosts. [Kalibera/Jones, ISMM 2013](https://kar.kent.ac.uk/33611/45/p63-kaliber.pdf).
- **Separate profiles:** profiling is gated after both timing comparisons, invokes real unchanged public methods and checks outputs. Call counts are diagnostic; cProfile seconds are not used as benchmark ratios or exclusive causal proof, consistent with the primary warning about unequal Python/C profiling overhead. [Pinned profiler documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.12.14/Doc/library/profile.rst).

## Endpoint/oracle/inference limits — not newly observed failures

**Previous-result disposal:** worker.py:43–45 measures `result = fn(...)` before its stop clock. Rebinding can deallocate the previous result inside that interval. Thus it is a statement-level public-call endpoint that can include previous-control disposal, particularly for tiny/empty calls following wide output. Common paired control order mitigates asymmetry, but shared additive work can attenuate ratios; its magnitude was not measured here. External normalization/checksum/comparison remains correctly outside. Do not relabel this as a pure callee-only measurement or change the frozen run post hoc. [Pinned assignment semantics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.12.14/Doc/reference/simple_stmts.rst).

**Oracle independence:** make_controls.py uses preserved historical exact float/mixed public results and algebraic projections/repetition for simple filter-free controls; new declared counters had to pass four actual roles. That is a predeclared golden regression oracle, not a wholly new declarative semantic oracle. Timed checksum evidence relies on the frozen worker's full normalized comparison, since all timed result objects are not retained. query_json normalization projects known fields and query metadata is stringified; it is not an independent exact-type/schema proof for arbitrary extra fields/objects. Separate correctness/source review gates remain essential.

**Recorded versus runtime evidence:** history_checksum_from_exact_template_receipt is deliberately receipt-derived, not a new post-open history scan. Threads1 and Python3.12.14 are checked by frozen worker code, but full interpreter version/mapped-module path and threads are not all independently retained in child meta. Captured affinity/default FP plus file hashes do not independently observe the past kernel or every call's controls. No exclusive-core/governor/host-resource, cold-start, arbitrary-state cleanup or whole-storage-performance claim follows.

**Statistics:** the bootstrap is descriptive per-control and assumes usable/exchangeable pair-level observations; 42 fresh pairs do not establish absence of temporal dependence or prove two warmups reach steady state. It is not a build/host hierarchy or family-wise multiple-comparison correction. Both rounds/order strata and every control, including tiny/no-float overhead, must remain visible. The predeclared median>1.05/lowerCI>1/both-rounds>1 screen triggers investigation, not equivalence or automatic acceptance. Absence of a signal does not exclude modest losses; profiles cannot uniquely attribute a signal to batch code versus all other bundle changes.

Root explicitly retains residual approximately 5–12% descriptive signals and holds item 2 for focused fresh research before any patch. This static review does not overturn that hold, accept item 2 or authorize further implementation. All earlier reviews and original 1.27× evidence remain frozen.
